name: Mercer | Mettl
summary: Mercer | Mettl sells online assessments with aptitude and psychometric tests, AI and human-based proctoring, and auto-graded coding evaluations. Its product pages list no prices, and the page routes buyers to a demo request.

facts.text: The product pages list aptitude tests and psychometric tests, including a General Aptitude Test and a Cognitive Abilities Assessment.
The product pages describe AI and human-based proctoring, secure browser controls and an AI-powered secured exam browser.
A case study on the page says all tabs apart from the exam tab were disabled to minimize cheating.
The page says coding tests offer auto-graded evaluations. A case study describes a credibility index report for each candidate.

plans.name: Demo and quote
plans.notes: The page shows no plan names or prices. It offers demo requests and a Pricing link.

hiddenCosts: No plan names, prices or minimums are published in the text read from the site.
